data.one_liner: A Dart wrapper for Twitter API v1.1 with typed models and endpoint methods.
data.what_it_does: The package provides typed service classes for Twitter v1.1 endpoints, handling OAuth1 authentication and parsing responses into Dart models. It also offers a low‑level client for custom requests.
use_when: You need to interact with Twitter's v1.1 REST API from a Dart/Flutter app
You prefer typed, documented methods over manual HTTP calls
avoid_when: You need Twitter API v2 support (use twitter-api-v2)
You require a lightweight HTTP client without code‑gen models
weaknesses: Only covers v1.1, not the newer v2 API
Adds build_runner step for code generation
Relies on http package, so no advanced features like interceptors
data.setup_notes: Add the package, run `dart pub get`, then execute `dart run build_runner build` to generate JSON models; configure OAuth1 credentials.
